|------|--------|-------|---------|

The repository owner checked on 2026-10-26 that the paper's arXiv license allows redistributing the PDF in this repository. Check the license again before replacing the file or adding another paper.

Keep fixtures within `PDF_PARSER__MAX_PAGES` (30 by default), or the parser skips them.
